notes: Do not use hass.components
Active options flow lives in config_flow.py
Use videos.list for video IDs
Do not log credential-bearing URLs
HA playlist states are transient
Missing servers gitlink requires --ignore-submodules=all for Git checks
Contract tests do not prove real HA/Cast compatibility
Original tree.md used a non-UTF-8 encoding; preserve backup before regeneration
The earlier transient-playlist limitation is superseded by Store persistence
Store.async_save logs some write failures internally; verify storage after saving
Do not reimport stale HA states when a saved store already exists
Serialize persistence and unload to avoid writes from a stale repository
Legacy state migration only works if states still exist before startup; lost transient states cannot be recovered
Invalid storage payloads must not be overwritten automatically
A media_player domain does not imply support for YouTube URLs or all stream formats
Media extractor is optional; do not require it for existing Cast actions
Current mode sends video media content type; audio-only extraction is not implemented
Media extractor may report downstream extraction/playback failures in HA logs; blocking delegation does not confirm physical playback
HTTP 400 alone does not identify an API key failure
Never print Google error message/metadata or request URLs
Only allowlisted constant reason codes may be displayed; unknown strings become UNKNOWN
Media extractor support is removed; earlier experimental instructions are superseded
Remove playback_mode from existing action data
ESPHome YouTube extraction and FFmpeg 403 errors are outside the supported Cast playback path
Native LLM platform support is detected by LLMTools availability; older HA uses a separately registered API
Recheck conversation exposure on every playback request
A completed service call does not prove physical playback
Keep credential values and backend exception text out of LLM responses
Live HA version and conversation agent compatibility still require deployment verification
Use entity registry platform == cast; entity names and shared physical devices do not prove Cast identity
Action selector filtering must be backed by runtime validation for YAML calls
Unregistered targets are rejected; Cast identity alone does not guarantee YouTube app support
Contributing tools to the existing Assist API does not register an independently selectable API
Always call helpers.llm.async_register_api for the requested provider and register its unload callback
Native-platform detection must not suppress standalone API registration; this supersedes the earlier fallback-only approach
Changes pushed only to dev require installing those files before live verification
